title: nightvision
body: NightVision (NV) is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows players to toggle night vision easily using a simple command. It helps improve visibility in dark areas such as caves, night time, and PvP arenas. The plugin is designed to be fast, simple, and lag-free with no extra dependencies. It works smoothly on modern Minecraft servers and is suitable for survival, PvP, practice, and building servers. Players can enable or disable night vision anytime depending on their needs./nv or /nightvision
